name: Switched-Mode Power Conversion
description: Review of steady-state operation of switching converters, dynamic modelling of DC-DC converters, analysis of time-domain and frequency-domain responses, controller design - P, PI, PID etc., for non-isolated and isolated DC-DC converters, voltage mode and current mode control, dynamic modeling of DC-DC converters in discontinuous conduction mode, peak current mode control, review of harmonics in AC systems, power factor correction methods in PWM rectifiers - boost PFC, totem-pole PFC etc., controller design for power factor corrected PWM rectifiers, EMI filter design and their effect on converter performance.
